autoload.description: Global singleton. Registered in project.godot. Always present.

class_named.description: Has class_name. Can be instantiated anywhere. No scene required.
class_named.scene_placement: optional — added to scene as Node child

addon.description: Lives in res://addons/. Has plugin.cfg. Extends EditorPlugin.

scene_script.description: Attached to a specific node in a specific scene. Cannot exist without its node.
scene_script.scene_placement: required — script IS the node behavior

tool_script.description: Has @tool annotation. Runs in editor. May also run in game.

orphan.description: Detected by data_bomb. No known attachment. Needs triage.
